member.name: T:ArcGIS.Desktop.Internal.NetworkAnalysis.Transportation.ViewModels.Ribbon.DropDownOfDistanceViewModelBase
member.summary:
For providing editing of distance (magnitude and length units) property.
This is intended to use as a custom drop-down control used on a ribbon tab containing an edit box and a combo box representing a length magnitude and units.
Using the frameworkControls:ComboBox caused interaction problems when changing enabled status while entire custom control (which includes a combobox) was not popped-down. Therefore using regular (System.Windows.Control) ComboBox instead to avoid this. If problem re-occurs, consider setting the Grid Visibility to Collapsed (the Grid containing a TextBox and ComboBox) when entire custom control is NOT popped-down. This would entail adding a property to bind this status. This may help if issue is layout related sizing problem when not popped-down.
